_help: Add a project: put an object in the right section. featured=true also shows it on the home page. status is optional (e.g. "Closed test", "Live", "Archived"). Then run _build/build.py.

items.name: Untangle Art
items.description: An Android arrow puzzle where every level hides a picture. In closed testing on Google Play.

items.name: Studio HQ
items.description: My private desktop app for running Vimora Studio: projects, releases, assets, uptime and automated jobs.

items.name: Automated YouTube content pipeline
items.description: Takes a topic to a finished video in the upload queue: research from competitor transcripts, scripts with the Claude API, images with ComfyUI, voice, and ffmpeg assembly. It runs five YouTube channels.

items.name: Document Q&A with retrieval
items.description: Upload PDFs and ask questions in plain language. It retrieves the relevant passages with overlapping context and answers from them.

items.name: Resume Scorer
items.description: Scores a resume against a job description, with strengths, gaps, match suggestions and tailored interview questions. Includes paid plans through Razorpay.

items.name: AI Mail Assist
items.description: Drafts email replies in the tone you pick: quick, formal or personal.

items.name: DSA practice bot
items.description: A Telegram bot that schedules data-structure and algorithm practice with spaced repetition, gives hints, and finds your weak topics.

items.name: Real-time order processing
items.description: Event-driven microservices with dead-letter queues, idempotent consumers and order state tracked in real time.

items.name: Spring Redis Forge
items.description: A distributed cache service: cache-aside, TTL expiry, pub/sub invalidation, circuit-breaker fallback and Micrometer metrics.

items.name: Microservices gateway reference
items.description: API gateway, service discovery and health checks, deployed with Helm and promoted from dev to staging to production by Jenkins.

items.name: Video streaming app
items.description: Upload, store and stream video with HTTP range requests, so playback can start and seek without downloading everything.
